competing_explanation.claim: The July PPI softening is a commodity retracement inside an intact price turn, not a loss of underlying momentum.
competing_explanation.why_plausible: A large run-up in the six-month change, {drv:diff(cn_ppi_yoy,6)@2026-07}, can be followed by a pullback in month-on-month prices while the year-on-year level, {obs:cn_ppi_yoy@2026-07}, stays elevated.
competing_explanation.discriminating_observation: Whether PPI month-on-month turns positive again in the next CPI and PPI release, and whether the PMI output price average recovers.
background_knowledge: Commodity-linked producer prices often retrace after a sharp supply-driven rise without implying a change in demand.

does_not_prove: That domestic demand has begun to broaden: one marginal core CPI flip is not breadth.
That the price turn has ended: the year-on-year level is far above where it was six months earlier.
That the mechanism is imported cost push: the data are consistent with it but do not identify it.

research_needs.question: Is producer-goods strength passing into consumer goods and core services?
research_needs.why_now: Consumer-goods PPI is still {obs:cn_ppi_consumer_yoy@2026-07} while core CPI barely moved.
research_needs.decision_it_could_change: Whether to treat H2 as unresolved rather than weakly supported.
research_needs.resolving_data: The next CPI and PPI release and the monthly retail sales release.

research_needs.question: Does the PMI output price index confirm the loss of PPI momentum?
research_needs.why_now: The PMI price average is {drv:ma(cn_pmi_output_price,3)@2026-07}, a weaker signal than the producer data.
research_needs.decision_it_could_change: Whether the H1 momentum test should be read as noise.

draft_analyst_update.text_template: July prices softened at the margin: PPI year-on-year eased to {obs:cn_ppi_yoy@2026-07} and the three-month momentum test flipped negative, while the only demand-side flip rests on a very small change in core CPI. The evidence fits a fading upstream-led bounce better than a broadening of demand, but one print does not settle it. This release alone does not indicate a change to the standing judgment.
